newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks close up despite late profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks close up despite late profit taking.

text.p: Thai stocks closed higher but profit taking in the finance sector in the afternoon shaved off gains in bank, telecommunications and commerce issues, brokers said.
The SET Index finished up 9.21 points at 952.48 on active eight billion baht turnover. The SET-50 ended up 1.00 point at 72.58.
"I think profit taking by regional buyers really hit the finance sector in the afternoon," said Youssef Aboud, investment analyst at Wall Street Finance and Securities.
"There is now a belief that U.S. interest rates will not go up in the long term and that will benefit regional stock markets where currencies are linked to the dollar," he said.
Abboud added that speculative buying of finance stocks was heavy on Thursday morning on reports that Thailand's battered property sector may receive government financial support.
He said the market would take a lead from regional bourses on Friday although prospects of its further gains appeared limited.
Loxley gained 14 baht to 200, Bangkok Bank added one to 197 and Telecom Asia rose three to 55.
